caption_en:
11 countries, 60 years, one finish line. ❤️

Who lives longest in the Middle East? ❤️

Life expectancy at birth, World Bank, 2023:
Israel 83.2
UAE 82.9
Qatar 82.4
Lebanon 77.8
Jordan 77.8
Iran 77.7
Turkey 77.2
Iraq 72.3
Syria 72.1
Egypt 71.6
West Bank and Gaza 65.2 (76.7 in 2022)

On the way: Lebanon fell 8 years in its civil war (1970 to 1975), Iraq slid through the 1980s, the UAE passed Israel around 2005, Syria lost 10 years in its civil war (2010 to 2015), Qatar led in 2019, and the pandemic hit the Gulf in 2020 and 2021.
2024, the latest year (not every country yet): Israel 83.2, UAE 83.1.
Not in the race: Saudi Arabia 78.7 (World Bank 2023); Bahrain, Kuwait and Oman are also under 82 (UN 2023).

Source: World Bank, World Development Indicators, SP.DYN.LE00.IN (via FRED). The animation interpolates between data points.

מי חי הכי הרבה במזרח התיכון? ישראל, 83.2 שנים (הבנק העולמי, 2023). איחוד האמירויות פחות מחצי שנה מאחור, וקטאר פחות משנה.
